summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Suzano S.A., a Brazilian pulp and paper company, presenting its quarterly financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial statements, segment information, and related notes in accordance with IFRS. There are no mentions of any mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or abrupt management changes. The filing is purely an earnings update and does not trigger any special-situation classification. Therefore, it falls outside all special-situations categories.
